title: INC: Card payments failing (processor_unavailable)
author: Miles Thornton
content:
h1. INC: Card payments failing (processor_unavailable)

Status: resolved.

h1. Window
2027-04-06 09:00 UTC to 2027-04-07 18:00 UTC.

h1. Impact
Card payments attempted in the window failed with `processor_unavailable`. Other billing operations were unaffected.

h1. Resolution
The payment processor restored availability. Every payment that failed in the window is retried automatically on the processor's usual retry schedule; customers don't need to do anything and no late fees apply.

h1. Customer guidance
Tell affected customers the failure was caused by a published payment-processor incident, that the payment will be retried automatically, and that no late fees apply.
